_doc: Delo Derby v2 board — WALL-NATIVE race on the PRODUCTION multiprocess recipe. Engine 'run_sweep_wall_slice': each chunk advances an idea by ONE wall-time slice (slice_secs) via `python scripts/run_sweep.py --cell <CELL> --resume <idea>/checkpoints/latest.pt --max-wall-secs <slice_secs> --final-eval`. That single command runs the full bundle (1 trainer + 8 selfplay_workers, wave-mode, GPU-saturated), self-caps with a clean resumable latest.pt, AND writes a fresh eval/model_elo line via --final-eval INSIDE the bundle (no separate eval step). Budget is wall-native: an idea caps when wall_secs_total >= cap_wall_secs. Priority = highest current elo (feed the leader); everyone reaches cap. ROSTER = the v1 top-3 (open-div4, temp-16, sgd-800), now as run_sweep CELL NAMES. The 'cell' key = the run_sweep.CELLS dict KEY; 'cell_name' = that Cell's .name (fixes the sweep_runs/<cell_name>/checkpoints path the derby reads from). These cells must be ADDED to run_sweep.CELLS before a REAL run (orchestrator owns run_sweep.py); the dry-run prints the planned command without them.

ideas.name: open-div4
